scenarios.scope: Fixed trusted native verifier and owned fixture; normal renderer process ownership is not a complete LPAC sandbox.
scenarios.acceptance: The authored owned-HKCU Rust gate is partial evidence only. Every original scenario check remains required; unavailable or unverified checks prevent complete parity. No assurance is retired because its old implementation used another language.

scenarios.limitation: Production writable output bind aggregate quota is unresolved; the helper tmpfs quota is not attributed to that bind.

excluded_assurances: host agent approval and message provenance

required_windows_diagnostic_obligations.requirement: Preserve original loader/SxS/CSR/debugger diagnostic role, order, status and owned-state restoration with equivalent Rust images. Removing the old-language runtime does not retire these invariants.
required_windows_diagnostic_obligations.partial_evidence: Native primary/descendant LPAC verifier and adversarial controller cases do not substitute for all actual diagnostic operations.

required_windows_diagnostic_obligations.requirement: Preserve original fixed SideBySide policy lease, identity, restoration and causal comparison under the approved native contract. An owned HKCU fixture is a separate scoped control, not an equivalent machine-policy receipt.
required_windows_diagnostic_obligations.partial_evidence: Owned-root read, mutation/private-child/foreign-file denials and scope=owned-fixture remain useful but do not complete this obligation.

required_windows_diagnostic_obligations.requirement: Preserve original owned physical-volume capacity, enforced NTFS logical-size quota and creator-owner closure checks in Rust. Job memory limits or file-size bounds are not disk-quota proof.
required_windows_diagnostic_obligations.partial_evidence: Job resource limits, bounded scratch, reparse rejection, identity-safe publication and process cleanup do not establish physical-volume or enforced-quota parity.
